output.scope_note: The paper is a DFT study of Li-ion transport and ionic conductivity in LiBO2 polymorphs (solid electrolyte candidates), and it reports computed room-temperature (300 K) Li-ion conductivities for vacancy-containing supercells.

records.measurement_method: DFT CI-NEB migration barrier with Einstein-Smoluchowski relation
records.evidence_quote: ionic conductivity (σ = 7.0 × 10−13 S cm−1 ) at 300 K
records.notes: Computed value (not measured). Pristine m-LBO with no vacancy; the 300 K value is the one stated in the text, derived from Eq. (5) with Em = 0.88 eV. Listed in Table 6 as well, but the table text is garbled so the quote is from the body text.
